answer_findings.RLPERFORMANCE-1: performance lens, low: Two grep-based subshell spawns parse the `acquired` field from JSON on every acquire path, while `jq` is already imported and used immediately below for the `holder` field. (core/claim/claim.sh: "_acquired_line="$(grep -o '"acquired":[[:space:]]*[a-z]*' <<< "$json_out" || true)"     acquired="$(grep -o 'true\|false' <<< "$_acquired_line" || true)""; happens when: Every successful `zbuild_claim_acquire` call on a run with an issue number: two subshell spawns run where one `jq` call would suffice.; fix: code; ACCEPTED IF: The `acquired` boolean is extracted without spawning more subshell processes than the `holder` extraction already requires.)
answer_findings.RLREDTEAM-3: red-team lens, medium: The graceful fallback in _ccgl_read_holder reads any GitHub commenter's holder string when the authenticated-actor filter produces no result, re-opening the spoofed-holder path that the actor filter was added to close. (plugins/claim-coordinator/github-labels/plugin.sh: "if [[ -z "$body" ]]; then                 # Graceful fallback: list without author filtering.                 body="$(gh issue comment list "$issue" --json body \                     --jq '[.[] | select(.body | contains("<!-- zbuild-run-status")) | .body] | last' \                     2>/dev/null || true)"             fi"; happens when: The fallback fires whenever $body is empty after the actor-filtered path: when gh api user fails and GITHUB_ACTOR is unset, when GITHUB_REPOSITORY is unset, or when the authenticated API call succeeds but returns no matching comment (e.g. the sidecar comment was not yet posted). Any GitHub user with comment access who posts a comment containing <!-- zbuild-run-status --> and <!-- zbuild-holder: PAYLOAD --> before the legitimate sidecar comment is scanned will have their PAYLOAD shown as the holder in the refusal message; ANSI sequences are stripped by claim.sh before printf, so terminal control injection is blocked, but the misleading attribution stands.; fix: code; ACCEPTED IF: The holder string shown in the refusal message is taken only from comments that the authenticated sidecar process itself wrote, not from any comment any GitHub user can post to the issue — the fallback that reads without author filtering must be removed or replaced with a path that still restricts to the authenticated actor's comments.)
